I need to write a JavaScript function that computes a running total of an array, but caps each cumulative sum at a given maximum value.

I drafted a loop-based implementation that tracks a running total and switches to the cap once exceeded. I also considered a simpler version using Math.min.

The Math.min approach is confirmed correct. Once the running total hits the cap, subsequent additions are clamped to that value. I also verified edge cases like empty arrays and all-zero inputs.
